text.en: Gemini 4 Argon API price doubles to $4 in / $20 out per 1M tokens.
text.zh: Gemini 4 Argon API 價格加倍為每百萬 tokens 輸入 $4 / 輸出 $20。

text.en: Pro (200) included usage reportedly lowered for new subscribers; price unchanged.
text.zh: 據報 Pro (200) 新訂閱者內含用量下調，價格不變。

text.en: Unlimited plain text chat reported for Free and Go.
text.zh: 據報 Free 與 Go 一般文字聊天改為不限量。

text.en: Scheduled end of the temporary +50% weekly limit bump (extension status unconfirmed).
text.zh: 暫時性每週額度 +50% 預定結束（是否延長尚未確認）。

text.en: Paid plans move to one weekly pool shared across Chat, Imagine and Voice.
text.zh: 付費方案改為 Chat、Imagine、Voice 共用一個每週額度池。

text.en: Gemini app switches from fixed daily prompts to compute-based limits (5-hour refresh, weekly cap).
text.zh: Gemini App 由每日固定提示數改為依運算量計算（每 5 小時重置、每週上限）。

text.en: Weekly limits raised 50% on Pro, Max, Team and seat-based Enterprise (temporary).
text.zh: Pro、Max、Team 與席位制 Enterprise 每週額度暫時提高 50%。

text.en: Claude Code 5-hour limits permanently doubled on paid plans.
text.zh: 付費方案 Claude Code 5 小時額度永久加倍。

text.en: New $100 Pro tier between Plus and the $200 Pro.
text.zh: 新增介於 Plus 與 $200 Pro 之間的 $100 Pro 方案。
